title: Learning courses on the intranet
summary: You can take new intranet learning courses from My learning: enrol, follow lessons, and track your progress. This is separate from My training in HR, which still points at the external compliance LMS.

added: My learning: see the courses you are enrolled on and how far you have got.
Course player: read lessons on phone or desktop and mark each lesson complete.
Learning managers can build courses with sections and lessons, enrol people (including by directory group), and set course prerequisites.
changed: Local development preview checks connect to MySQL more reliably when Herd’s status display is unclear.
accessibility: My learning is included in the automated accessibility check on desktop and phone widths.
